notes.title: Mine Of Madness Playtest Update 1.2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Fixes Implemented in 1.2:[/b][/h1]
 [b][h3]Flashlight Pickup Blocked by UI Widget[/h3][/b]

Fixed a bug where the flashlight couldn’t be picked up after restarting the game.
The UI widget was blocking the interaction—now removed!

[h3][b]Crouching/Uncrouching Stuck Bug[/b][/h3]

Improved my custom crouch system by adding a CanCrouch? flag before sprinting transitions.

No more getting stuck under objects—crouch/uncrouch now works smoothly even in tight spaces.

[h2][b]Crouch Clip at Grey Shirt Corpse[/b][/h2]

This was tied to the same crouch logic—also fixed with the new CanCrouch? checks.

[h1][b]Known Issues I’m Still Working On:[/b][/h1]

[h3][b] Input Lag[/b][/h3]

There’s still a slight delay between mouse input and character movement—currently investigating frame pacing, vsync, and GPU load.

[h3][b] Note Text Legibility[/b][/h3]

Some notes have small/hard-to-read text. Planning to increase font size and overall readability.

[h3][b] Flashlight Offset & Flicker[/b][/h3]

The flashlight is off-center and flickers in dark areas. Working to recenter the beam and ensure it’s always bright in low-light areas.

[h3][b] Main Lever Beeping Sound[/b][/h3]

After pulling the main lever, the loud beeping doesn’t stop. Will make sure this stops after using the lever.

[h3][b] Elevator Level Notes No Text[/b][/h3]
Some notes in the lower mine level don’t show text—checking my DataTable linkage to fix this.

notes.title: Update 1.1: New Look Behind Feature and Start Area Enhancements!
notes.content:
[list]
[h1][*][b]Update 1.1 Highlights:[/b][/h1]

[h2][*][b]Look Behind Feature:[/b][/h2]
- Hold the Right Mouse button or right controller bumper to smoothly look behind in first-person view.
- No impact on player control; feels natural and immersive.

[h2][*][b]New Start Area Scares:[/b][/h2]
- Added 2 new trigger-based jump scares in the starting zone.
- More intense early-game atmosphere; watch your back.

[h2][*][b]Environmental Details:[/b][/h2]
- Added new assets and props to the starting area.
- Enhanced clutter and lighting for a more lived-in look.

[h2][*][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/h2]
- Cleaned up static mesh warnings during level build.
- Blueprint logic fully commented for future updates.

[h2][*][b]Known Issues:[/b][/h2]
- Players might get stuck in areas, please hit the restart, looking into this!
- Players may experience stuttering near black goo, use DLSS for now!
- Please share feedback on the new camera controls.

[*]Thanks for playtesting and helping us improve Mine of Madness!
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Update: The Madness Begins!
notes.content:
[b]**Welcome to the first official Playtest for Mine of Madness!**[/b]

I've pushed my most stable playtest build, and now I need your feedback to help sharpen the tension, horror, and pacing.



[b]**WHAT’S INCLUDED**[/b]  
- Playable 1st and second area(WIP)   
- Interactables (WIP)
- Flashlight mechanic  
- Core puzzle flow
- EnemyAI Encounters(WIP)



[b]**HOW TO HELP**[/b]
- If you encounter bugs, visual issues, or weird behaviors [b]**we(me) want to know.**[/b]  
- If something scared you (or didn’t), [b]**we(me) want to know.**[/b]  
- If you finished it and had a thought about pacing, clarity, or quality, [b]**absolutely tell me.**[/b]

> We’re shaping this in real-time. Feedback goes straight to the dev team (me).



[b]**LEAVE FEEDBACK**[/b] 
Please Leave me detailed feedback in game, in the pause menu! it'll help me debug and get ideas from you!



[b]**REMEMBER:**  [/b]
This build is raw. That’s the point. It’s tension tested, glitch-sealed(somewhat), but meant to be experienced as a work in motion.

Thank you for descending into the madness with me!
